game.title: The Whispering Forest
game.intro: At dusk, you reach an ancient forest. A moss-covered path leads to ruined towers, while the river trail disappears beneath a veil of mist. Somewhere nearby, a silver bell rings once.
game.ruinsChoice: Follow the path to the ruins

results.ruins: Inside the ruins, you discover a silver key hidden beneath a loose stone. The bell rings again from deeper in the forest.
results.river: A troll leaps from the mist and wounds you before fleeing. You lose 3 health points, but find a healing herb by the river.
